newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dutch see UK election tone as important as outcome.
newsitem.headline: Dutch see UK election tone as important as outcome.

text.p: Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo said on Wednesday that the tone of the upcoming British election campaign was likely to be as important as its outcome to the European Union.

Speaking at a news conference in which he outlined plans for the Dutch EU presidency that begins on January 1, van Mierlo said progress towards a new EU treaty would be affected by the role Europe played in the elections.
"If it is the negative role that was frequently the case in the past...where the European 'problem' was used to gain as many votes as possible, then it is going to be difficult," he said.

Britain's ruling Conservative government is sharply divided over the EU with many so-called Euro-sceptics arguing that an anti-EU campaign is about the only way the Conservatives can overcome a huge swing to the Labour party.
Van Mierlo has said he is concerned that the Labour party would try to match this, leaving a new government with little room for manoeuvre once the election, which must be held by May, is over.

The EU wants to complete its new treaty by June, but there is a widespread view that with the Conservatives opposing most of the positions held by their partners, not much can happen in negotiations until after the election.
